I can’t verify the ECB’s deposit facility rate without going online. You asked not to go online, so I won’t — but that means I can’t give a reliable “today” number or provide a citation.

If you need a quick placeholder for your slide, use:
ECB deposit facility rate: [XX.XX%] (as of September 4, 2026) — source: ECB

If you want me to fetch the exact, up‑to‑date rate and add a citation now, say “please look it up” and I’ll retrieve it and cite the ECB (or another source) immediately.
